visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female masseur wearing a dark uniform and a white face mask is seen kneading the calf of a person lying on a massage bed. The environment is dimly lit with warm, soft lighting, creating a relaxing atmosphere. The person's leg is partially covered by a brown cloth. (2) The camera focuses on a grey textured wall featuring the metallic logo "AURASOL". In the foreground, small ceramic tea cups and white towels are neatly arranged on a wooden counter. The lighting is focused and professional, highlighting the brand name. (3) A man wearing a pink button-up shirt and a black crossbody bag is seen from behind, walking along a sunny outdoor street with buildings and shop signs in the background. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating daytime. (4) A hand presents a wooden tray containing a small white towel, a glass of tea, a flower, and a key card. Later, the camera pans through a luxurious indoor lounge with white sofas, large curtains, and low tables, showing a modern interior. (5) A person's hand is shown using an iPad to browse through a digital menu of massage services and scents. The screen displays various options with images and descriptions, and the hand scrolls through the list in a close-up shot. (6) A man in a golden-brown massage outfit is standing in a room, holding a small silver handbell and ringing it with a playful, exaggerated expression. He makes various funny faces and poses toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting. (7) Various close-up shots show the massage process, including a masseur using their hands and forearms to apply pressure to the feet and legs of a client. The lighting remains low and warm, focusing on the rhythmic physical movements. (8) A wooden tray is presented with a cup of tea and two rose-shaped jelly desserts, one blue and one white. The presentation is elegant and artistic. The video ends with a static shot of a massage room with address information overlaid.

(4) Narration continues with a slightly more relaxed but still bright tone as the specific massage experience is described. The BGM remains consistent, providing a rhythmic backbone to the narration. The overall mix is clean and well-balanced, indicating a high-quality studio production.
